title: Grateful Dead Live at NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadows Park on 1969-07-12
venue: NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadows Park
source: Partial SBD Recording Info: Pat Lee from Dick Latvala 1985; Technics 1506> Yamaha K2000 MSC > R > C > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture featuring a jazzy, vocal‑free China Cat Sunflower with an unusual three‑minute solo intro.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the unique, jazzy three‑minute solo introduction to China Cat Sunflower from the July 12 show, calling it one of the most amazing moments they’ve heard. The recording is presumed to be a soundboard source and is generally regarded as solid, with no reported flaws. Overall sentiment is very positive despite the limited commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high star ratings (5 and 4) and praised the performance, but only two brief reviews limit confidence in a precise rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on audio clarity; inferred soundboard source and generally praised by reviewer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Specific set‑list flow not discussed in the reviews.
